acceptanceCriteria: dogfood-check names each unlinked requirement ID, with a test.
preflight --plan accepts --witnesses with parity tests against preflight.
Capability listing is bounded or index-backed, with a measured before/after on a large tree.
body: Residuals of PR #1212 (TOL-V0-100..109): (1) dogfood-check prints only unlinked counts, not the requirement IDs, so the operator must re-derive them; (2) `preflight --plan` has no `--witnesses` flag, unlike preflight; (3) capability listing time grows with tree size (no bound or index use observed).
title: Obligations residuals from V1-1945/1946/1949: dogfood-check unlinked IDs, preflight --plan --witnesses, capability listing scales with tree size
